_about: How each kind of enemy fights in the rebuilt fight (rule 63b: 'Battle Brothers has its AI for the enemies correctly'; every archetype's behaviour from the library as data, before any skin). A behaviour is a set of switches the fight's one AI reads; each row quotes the wiki page (or Paolo's rule) it comes from. No number here is felt: the numbers they use (reach, hit chance, AP) are the rules' and the weapons'.

brigand_thug.quote: In the early game Brigand groups usually consist of [[Brigand Thug|Thugs]] and sometimes [[Brigand Raider|Raiders]].

lower_brigand_raider.quote: In the early game Brigand groups usually consist of [[Brigand Thug|Thugs]] and sometimes [[Brigand Raider|Raiders]].

brigand_raider.quote: Later, Raiders become more common, ranged attackers appear and their numbers increase

lower_brigand_marksman.quote: Their backline usually consists of [[Brigand Marksman|Marksmen]] who give Brigands ranged superiority, and if they think they have it, they will stand their ground and shoot at you.

brigand_marksman.quote: Their backline usually consists of [[Brigand Marksman|Marksmen]] who give Brigands ranged superiority, and if they think they have it, they will stand their ground and shoot at you.

brigand_poacher.quote: Their backline usually consists of [[Brigand Marksman|Marksmen]] who give Brigands ranged superiority

wiederganger.quote: They don't have any idea about careful approach and instead slowly walk towards you

direwolf.quote: Direwolves rush you even if they will have no AP left to attack.

line.quote: However, Brigands are often too undisciplined to maintain formation. Some of them can run towards you even when they have ranged superiority.

backline.quote: if they think they have it, they will stand their ground and shoot at you

hunt.value: an enemy that sees nobody walks the shortest open path toward your crew, never through a house
hunt.quote: Battle Brothers has its AI for the enemies correctly
hunt.why: measured on the frozen fight (V165): enemies who never see you hold forever and the fight never ends
